To route only this tool's downloads through WARP, first install the official WARP client yourself. Go to Preferences → Advanced → Configure Proxy, enable Local proxy, and choose a port (menus may vary by version).
Then enable WARP local proxy in the App's Advanced settings and enter the same port (default: 40000). Only tag search, author backfill, and media downloads use the proxy; the sign-in browser uses the operating system's network settings.
The App does not install, enable, or switch WARP, or automatically change system DNS. Proxy failures are reported; the App will not automatically switch to a direct connection.
1.1.1.1 mainly handles DNS queries; WARP changes the traffic route. Any improvement depends on your network. It does not guarantee faster access to X or provide anonymity.
If the connection is slow, check whether X opens in a normal browser, pause other downloads, or try again later. Completed download records are kept for future backfill.

Close the App's dedicated browser first. Your everyday Chrome/Edge is unaffected; downloads, history and settings are kept.
This removes local copies only, without revoking X/Google server sessions. Revoke those separately on the website's account security page if needed.

gallery-dl 更新需要重新建置 App；只更新原始碼環境不會改變現有 E: Updating gallery-dl requires rebuilding the App. Updating only the source environment does not change an existing EXE.
{source_name} 未完成（{error_type}）；請檢查登入或網路: {source_name} incomplete ({error_type}); check sign-in or network and retry.
續跑工作 {job_id}：已完成來源略過；未完成來源重新列舉並依媒體紀錄去重，: Resuming job {job_id}: finished sources are skipped; unfinished sources are listed again and deduplicated from media history, not resumed from pagination cursors.
設定起始日期並勾選分段搜尋，會以 30 天為一段查詢，仍遵守搜尋上限。\n相同設:
Set a start date and enable date windows to search in 30-day segments, still within the search quota.
The same settings can resume unfinished jobs. Finished sources are skipped; unfinished segments may be scanned again, while downloaded media stays deduplicated. Search posts already seen by this job do not use this run's quota again.
An unfinished job keeps its originally scheduled date range. To query newer dates immediately, turn off Resume unfinished collection jobs and start a new job.
「更多功能 → 下載紀錄與收集進度」可篩選下載結果、開啟檔案，以及只重試選取的失:
More tools → Download history and collection progress lets you filter results, open files and retry only selected failed items. The progress tab lists unfinished sources.
Clear local sign-in data asks for confirmation and removes only this App's Cookie and dedicated browser data, keeping downloads and history. Check App and extractor updates only queries official version information, without automatic downloads or installation.
